The Roadmap

A clear route from first message to launch.

A practical sequence keeps the project easy to follow and gives every design and build decision a reason.

01

Share the idea

Tell me what you do, who the website is for, and what you want visitors to do next.

02

Gather the content

Collect your logo, copy, photos, contact details, examples, and any links the project needs.

03

Shape the layout

Arrange the key sections into a clear journey, with mobile visitors and accessibility in mind.

04

Build the experience

Develop the visual style, interactions, responsive behavior, and page structure for the agreed scope.

05

Review the details

Check text, links, layout, and contact actions together before the final version goes live.

06

Publish & improve

Connect the real domain and hosting, then use feedback to decide what to refine next.

Quick Answers

Good questions before you get started.

Not sure what to send or where to begin? These answers help turn a rough idea into a useful first conversation.

What information should I send first?

Share a short description of your idea or business, who you want to reach, the pages or features you need, and any examples you like. You can also include your preferred timeline.

Can the website work on mobile phones?

Responsive layouts are part of the design approach. The page should adapt to phone, tablet, and desktop screens, and important controls should remain easy to use.

Can you help with website content and images?

I can help organize the sections and suggest what information belongs on each page. Please provide approved business facts, original photos, and any brand assets you want included.

Will my website appear on Google right away?

SEO-friendly structure helps search engines understand a site, but indexing and rankings are controlled by search engines and are not guaranteed. A published website can be submitted through Google Search Console.

Can I add my social media links later?

Yes. Social links, new project examples, updated service information, and other content can be added as your online presence grows.

How do I ask about a project or pricing?

Use the contact form or email me directly with a short project description. The price depends on the pages, features, content, and overall scope we agree on.
